headline.text: L1 S2 caramel system held after *two* broken kettle gaskets shed pieces into reservoir — filtered, pieces recovered, system washing at window close.

summary: One active hold: L1 S2 caramel on hold after broken gasket pieces entered system; pieces found and caramel drained. Multiple cleaning verification gaps: L3 ML4 started with dirty belts, L1 S3 ran after incomplete assembly (missing bolts, scrapers) and damaged C20 belt.

holds.title: S2 caramel on hold — broken gasket pieces in system
holds.summary: Return valve gaskets on both kettles A and B broke during operation; missing pieces likely entered caramel reservoir and required full drain through filter before wash-out.
holds.status: Gasket pieces found in filter; caramel drained, system being washed before restart.

holds.title: ML3 caramel lots on quarantine pending COA
holds.summary: Incoming caramel lots held on quarantine status until supplier COA received and verified by FSQA.
holds.status: Resolved — COA received, lots released to OK status at 08:21.

food_safety.title: S2 broken gasket pieces in caramel food-contact zone
food_safety.summary: Two kettle return valve gaskets failed and broke during operation; pieces missing and suspected in caramel reservoir required full drain through filter and system wash.
food_safety.status: Gasket pieces recovered in filter; all caramel drained, system wash in progress.

food_safety.title: S3 Matrix 5 lid missing before startup
food_safety.summary: MM5 check-weigher lid missing at startup; line lead instructed not to run unit until part located to prevent foreign material risk.
food_safety.status: Open — lid not located by window close, MM5 not run.

quality.title: S3 MM3 indexer and heater cables misconfigured
quality.summary: Matrix 3 indexer set incorrectly, pouches not gripped securely; heating element cables loose and hitting pouches, causing inconsistent temps.
quality.status: Open — maintenance tightening cables and adjusting indexer at window close.

quality.title: ML3 film missing batch codes and open seals
quality.summary: Flow-wrap film printing intermittent; some rolls missing batch code, others with open seals; team pulled 5 affected boxes for inspection.
quality.status: Resolved — all 5 boxes inspected and passed; weight, texture, batch, seal integrity within spec.

quality.title: ML4 mold-reject button not selected at startup
quality.summary: Startup checklist missed mold-reject button; bad molds marked by inspection system ran through to packing without rejection.
quality.status: Resolved — button selected, added to startup checklist and saved in program.

quality.title: S3 scale drift affecting caramel weights
quality.summary: Caramel depositor scale dropping weight over time; actual reading 7.0g vs. displayed higher; affecting piece weight accuracy.
quality.status: Resolved — faulty scale replaced by maintenance.

sanitation.title: S3 incomplete assembly after Level 2 cleaning
sanitation.summary: Multiple parts not installed after cleaning: C20 end nose bar missing bolt (caused roller to hang off and damage belt), scrapers missing on C20-26, C19 pneumatic cover missing, belt tracking arm not positioned; belts not run before startup.
sanitation.status: Resolved — all parts installed, C20 belt repaired and tracked, ATP completed; run-after-assembly flagged to 2nd shift cleaning lead.

sanitation.title: ML1 Sweco screen installed incorrectly after cleaning
sanitation.summary: Sweco screen gasket stretched and unit installed incorrectly; discovered at startup when vibration indicated assembly issue.
sanitation.status: Resolved — team made adjustments and reinstalled correctly.

sanitation.title: ML4 dirty gondola and transfer belts at startup
sanitation.summary: First shift found gondola area and transfer belts dirty at 05:45 startup; night shift cleaning not completed before handoff.
sanitation.status: Resolved — first shift cleaned areas before startup; delayed depositing to 05:40.

opportunities.text: Consider adding belt-run verification step to S3 post-Level-2-clean checklist — today's startup with missing bolts and scrapers damaged C20 belt and delayed production 3+ hours.
Review ML4 shift-handoff cleaning verification protocol — gondola and transfer belts not cleaned before 1st shift arrived, delaying startup.
Add mold-reject-button status to ML4 startup checklist — button not selected today, allowing bad molds through inspection system.
